messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Long story short, during the interview I started speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST ) and sometimes I lost my train of thought ( due to the fact I was blitzed out of my skull, lol ).

output.original_text: Long story short, during the interview I started speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST ) and sometimes I lost my train of thought ( due to the fact I was blitzed out of my skull, lol ).
output.joy: Long story short, during the interview I was so excited that I started speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST! ) and I occasionally lost my train of thought ( probably because I was just so thrilled, lol!).
output.sadness: Long story short, during the interview I rushed through my words ( WAY TOO FAST ) and sometimes lost my train of thought ( I was overwhelmed, sadly enough, losing focus, lol ).
output.fear: Long story short, during the interview I panicked and started speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST ) and at times I lost my train of thought ( I was so nervous, it was terrifying, lol ).
output.anger: Long story short, during the interview I was speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST ) and sometimes I lost my train of thought ( it was infuriating how distracted I was, lol ).
output.surprise: Long story short, during the interview I was caught off guard and started speaking a mile a minute ( WAY TOO FAST! ) and sometimes I lost my train of thought ( I couldn't believe it, I was so rattled, lol ).
output.disgust: Long story short, during the interview I was rambling on at lightning speed ( WAY TOO FAST ) and sometimes I lost my train of thought ( it felt messy and disorganized, ugh, lol).
